current.text: He joined the Lakers from the Raptors after a breakout season in Toronto.
LeBron James left for the Sixers and Rui Hachimura is gone. That opens forward minutes and usage. The Lakers' core is Luka Doncic, Austin Reaves, Walker Kessler and Mamukelashvili.
Two Lakers starting spots are open. The main candidates are Grimes, LaRavia and Mamukelashvili. Ziaire Williams might also start.
Experts see him as the backup center behind Walker Kessler, with some minutes at power forward next to Kessler. His minutes should go up in that role.
Even the player who comes off the bench in this group should play about 27 minutes.
Josh does not think he will start, and that limits his value.
He is a late-round flyer whose value depends on whether he starts. One expert loves him in tier nine. He went for 4 USD in an auction mock draft.
The Lakers' defense depends on Kessler, and the backup centers are weak. If Kessler is out, they would have to rely on Looney or Mamukelashvili.

durable.text: He is a good shooter with strong offense. His value relies on volume and efficient three-point shooting.
He makes clearly more threes than most forwards and centers.
2025-26 was his only season in a regular rotation role.

note: Yahoo ranks him 139 with a value of 3 USD and an average cost of 1.0 USD, so he sits right at the edge of our 144-player draft. Pay 1 to 2 USD only as a final-round flyer. His projected 1.9 threes and 5.9 rebounds help builds that want threes from the frontcourt, but he adds few blocks for a big. Early in the season, check whether he wins a starting spot over Grimes, LaRavia or Ziaire Williams and whether he plays close to 27 minutes. If he does not, leave him on waivers and grab him if Kessler gets hurt.
